rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for beating an opponent in a battle, game, or contest.

example.english: We managed to defeat our opponents in the final.
example.traditional: 我哋喺決賽打敗咗對手。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hai2 kyut3 coi3 daa2 baai6 zo2 deoi3 sau2

rows.note: Use this when framing the result from the winner's side, as in beating someone in a game or contest.

example.english: We managed to defeat them in this match.
example.jyutping: gam1 coeng4 bo1 ngo5 dei6 jeng4 zo2 keoi5 dei6

rows.note: Use 失敗 as the all-purpose noun for a defeat or loss when no narrower contest wording is needed.

example.english: This defeat in the exam left me really disappointed.
example.traditional: 今次考試嘅失敗，搞到我好失望。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 haau2 si2 ge3 sat1 baai6 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 hou2 sat1 mong6

rows.note: Use this specifically for losing a game, match, or other contest.

example.english: We are already facing defeat in this match, so there is no need to keep chasing.
example.traditional: 呢場波已經係輸局，唔使再追喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 coeng4 bo1 ji5 ging1 hai6 syu1 guk6 m4 sai2 zoi3 zeoi1 laa3

rows.note: Use this for stopping a plan, action, or intended result from being achieved.

example.english: The police stopped this plot in time and helped defeat it.
example.traditional: 警方及時阻止咗呢個陰謀。
example.jyutping: ging2 fong1 kap6 si4 zo2 zi2 zo2 ni1 go3 jam1 mau4

rows.jyutping: daa2 baai6 N ni1 gin6 si6
rows.note: Use this nominalizing construction to refer to the act of defeating N.

example.english: The defeat of the opponent gave me a real sense of satisfaction.
example.traditional: 打敗對手呢件事，令我好有滿足感。
example.jyutping: daa2 baai6 deoi3 sau2 ni1 gin6 si6 ling6 ngo5 hou2 jau5 mun5 zuk1 gam2
